video_title: The Hornets actually WON the trade because they can go get ANOTHER star 👀

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets' roster flexibility after trading LaMelo Ball
quotes.excerpt: They have 50 million dollars in cap space to make a deal. So they can go find another star.
quotes.quote: They don't believe in LaMelo Ball. If they don't believe in LaMelo, you gave Kobe a shot. I don't think Kobe's the answer, but you have 50 million dollars in cap space to make a deal. So they can go find another star. I think Naz Reid is a really great player. I think we've been seeing him be underutilized. So when you look at the starting lineup, I think they need to get a better big. You have Naz Reid, you have Brandon Miller, and you have Kon Knuppel, and you can go find another star with your luxury space. And I think Kobe White is probably mid-tier. I think he's better than Quick. I don't think he's the best starting point guard, but I think he's a solid starting point guard until you can figure out what you want to do there if he's not good enough. So I think that they have put themselves in prime space for flexibility to make their decision with a great core with Brandon Miller, Naz Reid, and Kon Knuppel.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets' positive trajectory after end of season
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the way Charlotte ended the season last year, they are on the right trajectory.
quotes.quote: I think they got better. I like Naz. I feel like the way Charlotte ended the season last year, they are on the right trajectory. Naz is a big pickup. They got the big, Bate, whatever his name is. I'm rolling. I'm rolling unless they are going to trade Bridges. What are they going to do with Bridges? We don't know yet. Brandon Miller is a stud. Kobe White, he's a hooper. And in the game, you got the nipple. He saved them in that game, right? He saved them. I do agree, you said it earlier, you said I think they figured them out. I think the league is going to figure them out. I think Charlotte got slightly better.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets' potential trade for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: This is a great trade if they are able to get Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: If they don't get Jaylen Brown, this is an absolutely terrible trade. This is a great trade if they are able to get Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's chemistry and team dynamics in Charlotte
quotes.excerpt: LaMelo Ball has never seen disgruntled about Charlotte, never spoke ill will about Charlotte.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: LaMelo Ball has never seen disgruntled about Charlotte, never spoke ill will about Charlotte. They were encouraged on how they ended the season. We were in here talking yesterday, we didn't even know if Miami was better than Charlotte, how they were currently constructed, because how they ended the season. And now you build on that. You bring another big in, they drafted another big who can go in there and be serviceable for those guys, who can run with those guys. The Hornets were playing good basketball and they were growing. You expected Kon Knuppel to get a little bit better.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Now you're asking Kon Knuppel to do more than I think he is ultimately capable of.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Importance of a general-level playmaker for team success
quotes.excerpt: You need a general to win the... unless your general can get buckets like Jaylen Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You need a general to win the... unless your general can get buckets like Jaylen Brunson. Or you have a five-man that can pass like Karl-Anthony Towns. In the town, took another role where he was just a playmaker. If you don't have that, it's going to be a problem.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: So let's use De'Aaron Fox as a measuring stick. Is De'Aaron Fox really a true playmaker?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: De'Aaron Fox can make plays. He's more of a score first, right? He can make plays, but is he really a true playmaker? He's not a true playmaker. He's more of a score first, right?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe White's role as a scorer versus playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I want Kobe to be Kobe. I don't want Kobe thinking about playmaking. Kobe's an elite score.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I want Kobe to be Kobe. I don't want Kobe thinking about playmaking. Kobe's an elite score. De'Aaron Fox can make plays. My problem is, I was asking if De'Aaron Fox can make plays. That's my thing, is can Kobe play that role? It's just two different teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: He can make plays, but is he really a true playmaker? He's more of a score though, right?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets' need for a superstar player
quotes.excerpt: There's no one else. You're not getting Jaylen Brown. You're not getting Kawhi Leonard.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: There's no one else. You're not getting Jaylen Brown. You're not getting Kawhi Leonard. You think Kawhi is going to Charlotte? Your only chance is getting a superstar.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: But I'm saying if they go find another star, you need it has to be Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets' outlook for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: The way the team is constructed right now, I feel like Charlotte is going to play better.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The way the team is constructed right now, I feel like Charlotte is going to play better. They are going to win more games than they won last year.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: You think Charlotte is going to be better this year than they were last year?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Yes. I think they're going to be better.

text_blocks.text: Hey, Ray, Ray. Ray, what's up?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: What it do, what it do.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: How you feeling, Ray? You feeling a year older?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Not yet. One more day.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: It's birthday tomorrow.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of trading for Jaylen Brown on team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: When you bring in somebody like Jaylen Brown, you kind of change... you take away from them.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: When you bring in somebody like Jaylen Brown, you kind of change... you take away from them being a team that you got multiple guys that can that can beat you. You're talking about a guy that's going to want the ball, who's going to demand 25 shots a game, and then you take away from them being a team that you got multiple guys that can that can beat you.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You got to play a whole different way now. You know that, right?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluation of Charlotte Hornets' trade and roster changes
quotes.excerpt: Charlotte didn't get worse. Put like that. I can't say they got worse.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Charlotte didn't get worse. Put like that. I can't say they got worse. They didn't get worse, but I can't say they got better either because you lose a guy like LaMelo, like Theo said, a playmaker, a guy that kind of ran your team, you know, you you you lose something there, especially offensively. But yeah, you do add Naz, a big man that can score, you know, that can rebound, that can play. But then also you lose your point guard too. So I don't know, they didn't lose and they didn't necessarily win either, bro.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: So they stayed even.
